mainTask.title: Outline the second portfolio case study
mainTask.description: Create a simple bullet outline for your second case study: the problem, your role, two or three key decisions, and the outcome. Aim for a rough skeleton, not polished writing.
mainTask.reason: This continues the case study you started yesterday and moves your portfolio goal forward with a smaller, concrete first step.
